name: Thirty-Second Fix
why_it_works: Watching a small problem get solved in real time is deeply satisfying, and the viewer walks away able to do it themselves. That gift of competence makes people save and share, and it proves the brand knows its craft without a single boast.

hook.pattern: Show the annoying problem up close and promise it is fixed before the video ends.
examples: Don't pay anyone for this. Here's the fix.
Everyone has this problem. Watch it disappear.

variables.name: problem
variables.description: The small, common problem, as people describe it

variables.name: tool
variables.description: The everyday tool or product used

variables.name: step_1
variables.example: Tape off the paint around the lens

variables.name: step_2
variables.description: Second step, the one with the most motion
variables.example: Wet-sand in straight lines, coarse to fine grit

variables.name: step_3
variables.example: Wipe clean and seal with UV clear coat

variables.name: result
variables.description: What the viewer gets, in plain words
variables.example: Clear lenses and brighter night driving

beats.voiceover: {{problem}}? Let's fix it in thirty seconds.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 extreme close-up of {{problem}}, harsh raking light that shows every flaw, garage or workbench background softly blurred
Vertical overhead photo of hands doing '{{step_1}}' with {{tool}} visible, clean workbench, even soft shop light
Vertical 9:16 close-up of hands performing '{{step_2}}' in smooth steady motion, shop light, shallow depth of field, real texture and detail
Vertical close-up photo of the finishing touch '{{step_3}}', glossy surface catching a soft highlight, clean background
Vertical 9:16 slow pull-back revealing the fixed item looking like new, warm golden light, {{brand}} shop or crew softly visible behind

beats.voiceover: Save it, try it, and follow {{brand}} for the next one.

cta: Save this, try it this weekend, and follow {{brand}} for the next fix.

craft.notes: Light the problem harshly and the result warmly so the change reads instantly. Each step gets one short instruction on screen; the viewer should be able to pause and follow along. Hold the result shot a full beat longer than feels necessary.

do_not: Show any unsafe shortcut (no jack stands, no eye protection, chemicals without gloves)
Teach a fix that legally or safely needs a certified pro, like brakes, airbags or electrical
Speed-ramp through the steps so fast nobody can follow them
